name: Azure Blob Storage
summary: List, fetch and publish blobs in Azure Blob Storage and Data Lake Storage Gen2 with an account key, a SAS token or Microsoft Entra ID.

fields.name: sas_token
fields.label: SAS token
fields.help: The query string of a SAS URL for the account, container or blob.

auth.label: Managed identity of the daemon host

settings.name: hierarchical_namespace
settings.label: Data Lake Storage Gen2 account
settings.help: On if the account has a hierarchical namespace; Ogun then uses the dfs endpoint.

egress.note: login.microsoftonline.com is used only by the Entra ID methods. Azure operated by 21Vianet uses other domains and is not covered.

operators.summary: List blobs under a prefix as a manifest.
Fetch blobs into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3, resumable by range.
Publish artifacts under a blob prefix with block upload and a recorded digest.

notes: Staging store for Azure Synapse and Microsoft Fabric loads (see those connectors). Anyone holding an account key can read the whole account; prefer a SAS token or Entra ID.
